title: Companies Prosecuted for Illegal Discharge of Wastewater into Public Sewage System
what_it_is: Companies Prosecuted for Illegal Discharge of Wastewater into Public Sewage System

sections.label: PUB prosecutes illegal trade effluent discharge
sections.summary: PUB has prosecuted 119 companies since 2014 for illegal trade effluent discharge, with repeat offenders facing harsher penalties, inspections, suspension or revocation, and stop-orders for hazardous substances.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: While most companies abide by the quality requirements, PUB has prosecuted 119 companies since 2014 for illegal discharge of trade effluent into the sewers, where the discharge did not comply with stipulations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Of these, 21 companies are second-time offenders and another 23 companies committed the offences more than two times.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Repeat offenders will face harsher penalties and be subjected to more frequent inspections by PUB.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: PUB may also suspend or revoke the Written Approval granted to the company for the discharge of trade effluent into the sewers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For severe cases where the discharge contains toxic, dangerous or hazardous substances, PUB will issue an immediate stop-order notice to prevent the company from further discharging trade effluent into the public sewers.

sections.label: Written Approvals for trade effluent discharge
sections.summary: Written Approvals to discharge trade effluent into public sewers have been given to about 5,000 premises or companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding the first question about repeat offenders with multiple offences, let me first say that Written Approvals for companies to discharge trade effluent into our public sewers, currently, have been given to about 5,000 premises or companies.

sections.label: Increased surveillance for repeat offenders
sections.summary: For repeat offenders, onsite surveillance visits would be increased to as often as twice a month if need be.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For repeat offenders, we would increase the onsite surveillance visits to as often as even twice a month, if need be.

sections.label: Enhanced enforcement and penalty regime
sections.summary: Enhancements to the enforcement and penalty regime make offenders liable to fines of up to $50,000 or $100,000 for discharging hazardous, toxic substances into public sewers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Enhancements to the enforcement regime and penalty regime have also been made.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, they are not just liable to a fine of up to $50,000 or $100,000 if they discharge hazardous, toxic substances into our public sewers.
